<!-- pr-reviewer: 9462a2c5669875576308e4555822cf86ecca42a7 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a safety review because the change affects geometry import.

- The face and edge meters share one pass budget. Each meter counts its first refusal once.
- A stopped pass cannot keep a mesh from an earlier pass. A meter that the stop cuts short does not cause a false face refusal.
- The tests cover many broken faces, one broken face, edge trips, pass reset, and the refusal text.
- No UI files, golden files, dependencies, or build scripts changed. No golden comparison was required.

Local results: the trial merge with upstream/main at `31f8d03d744e77ce707282d816e11efe0922f239` was clean. That commit is already in this PR. All checks ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2084`. No GitHub runner was used.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed in 168 seconds. It built and ran these tests:

| Test suite | Passed | Ignored |
|---|---:|---:|
| app unit tests | 339 | 1 |
| bore_facet_sagitta | 2 | 0 |
| import_outward | 4 | 0 |
| import_step_closed_shell | 6 | 0 |
| import_step_corner_blend | 3 | 0 |
| import_step_curve_guard | 3 | 0 |
| import_step_doubly_curved | 1 | 0 |
| import_step_guard | 6 | 0 |
| import_step_guard_default_cap | 1 | 0 |
| import_step_open_shell | 4 | 0 |
| import_step_outward | 3 | 0 |
| import_step_thread | 1 | 0 |
| large_models | 3 | 1 |
| model_fidelity | 9 | 0 |
| step_budget | 6 | 0 |
| step_chord_units | 3 | 0 |
| step_fidelity | 2 | 0 |
| step_nesting | 8 | 0 |
| stock_export | 2 | 0 |
| Total | 406 | 2 |

No tests failed. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

I repeated two mutation checks from the PR:

1. Remove the stopped-pass check from `Meter::spend`: RED.
2. Remove the stopped-pass check from `Meter::spend_many`: RED.

Both failed the PR test `the_pass_stops_at_the_trip_limit_and_a_stopped_meter_is_not_a_trip` with `a stopped pass evaluates nothing more`. The original code passed before and after the mutations. These checks used temporary copies of the meter module and that test in a separate Rust test program under `/tmp`. The program used small substitutes for the error and fault types. The PR files were not changed. The full app tests above used the original PR code.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes: the release-only heavy tests were not run. The two ignored tests remain ignored. The whitespace check reports CRLF line endings in the changed integration test; the file already used CRLF.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
